ambient: Everyone turns a page at once. You don't have a page.
Somebody at the far end says your name in the middle of a sentence, and continues.
The chair beside you is pulled out, and pushed back in.
description: A long table, a great many chairs, and everybody knows what this is about except you. There are papers at every seat, face down. Someone is standing at the end waiting for you to sit so they can begin. You're already sitting.
name: The Meeting

looks: Face down. Everyone else’s are face up and identical to the back of yours.
You turn one over. It's a photograph of the table, taken from where you're sitting.
They're minutes. Of this. Including this.
objects.name: the papers

looks: Waiting, with enormous patience, for something you have already done.
Their name is on a card in front of them, and it's a word, not a name.
They have begun. You have missed the beginning. It's going well.
objects.name: the person standing

weather: The room is air-conditioned several degrees past comfortable. It has been like this for years.
